description: SOURCES CONFLICT. OSM records the airframe now standing on ul. Połczyńska in the Świdwin garrison estate as an Iskra; a gk24.pl local-history feature says the airmen's monument raised there on 12 October 1976 carried a MiG-19PM which was blown off its plinth in a windstorm and replaced with a retired MiG-17. Recorded here with the OSM type because it is the later observation; the type must be confirmed on site
aliases: TS11; Iskra; MiG-19PM; MiG-17; MiG19PM; MiG17
